## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote this contribution myself or have the right to submit it under the Eclipse Public License 2.0, and every commit
      is signed off (`git commit -s`), as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/skyplayser/LJ-Link/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin)
      (Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1).
- [ ] LJ Link stays passive: no sync, master, tempo or fader commands to players or mixers.
- [ ] No telemetry, no cloud services, no proprietary assets (logos, fonts, artwork) of other makers.
